_comment: Drives the local-coding-agent stack (rMLX by default, mlx-lm as fallback). Both serve the same OpenAI-compatible port, so nothing here changes when you run `agent-serve runtime mlx-lm`.

runtime._switch: The server holds ONE model resident (--max-loaded-models 1), so changing model is a restart, not a request field. The runner shells out to these between models. Set --no-switch to manage it yourself.

_models: Three sizes, ONE family, one quantisation -- isolates scale from post-training. `registry_key` is the name `agent-model use` expects; `model` is the HF repo. Register them first: agent-model add qwen2.5-3b --repo mlx-community/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct-4bit --size 2 && agent-model pull qwen2.5-3b
_e1_tiers: core = the original 30 tasks; hard = 15 that a 3B does not saturate. Calibration measured the core set at 86.7% for 3B with 22/30 pinned at 100%, which leaves no headroom for a harness effect on the upper rungs. Drop to ["core"] only if your whole ladder sits below ~1.5B.
